content: Ananya Nair confirmed details about a health insurance policy: coverage for pre‑existing conditions with a two‑year waiting period, monthly premium payment option with a 5% surcharge, total premium of about 25,000 per year for a family of three, and the next step is for the agent to send a payment link and request required documents.

action_items: Agent to send a payment link to the customer
Customer to complete payment and upload required documents
